title: PipeRoute · audio routing
tooltip: Left click: patch links, create virtual devices, route streams
badGraph: Could not read the PipeWire graph
noLinks: No links in the graph right now.
noNodes: No virtual devices created by PipeRoute yet.
hint.patch: Pick an output port (a stream or a device monitor), then an input port (a device playback port) to patch them together.
hint.connect: Now pick the input port to complete the link. Click the output name again to cancel.
hint.virtual: Virtual outputs give apps a destination you can patch onward. Virtual inputs act as a microphone other apps can record from. Both are removed when you click Destroy.
